snippet.title: JUST. ONE. MORE. DROP. | HYPERDROP: A Pachinko Roguelite Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
HYPERDROP is a hypnotic, mind-melting pachinko roguelite where you'll chase impossible scores by building a board and watching it explode with game-breaking combos and satisfying chain reactions to the tune of a dynamic, pulsing electronic soundtrack.

Just. One. More. Drop.
